title: Nigeria-US Joint Airstrike Kills 21 ISWAP Fighters in Arege, Borno
detail: A precision Nigeria-US joint airstrike killed 21 ISWAP fighters — including three mid-level commanders — at a concealed staging area in Arege, Kukawa LGA, Borno State on May 30. The operation was coordinated using US AFRICOM satellite imagery and signals intelligence gathered in the two weeks following the May 16–18 joint raids that killed ISIS global leadership figure Abu-Bilal al-Minuki and approximately 175 militants. The May 30 strike targeted a key ISWAP logistics corridor linking Nigeria, Niger, and Chad, aiming to disrupt the group's northeastern supply and command network. Nigerian Air Force assets executed the strike in coordination with AFRICOM. The operation forms part of the continuing Nigeria-US counterterrorism partnership established in early May 2026.

title: Bandits Abduct Retired Major General Rabe Batsari and Wife in Katsina
detail: Retired Major General Rabe Abubakar Batsari, former Director of Defence Information, and his wife Hajiya Amina Abubakar were ambushed by armed bandits along the Marabar Musawa–Kafinsoli road in Matazu LGA, Katsina State, while travelling to a wedding. Their driver was also taken. By June 1, bandit leader Kachallah Muhammad made contact with the family and demanded a prisoner exchange — the release of jailed gang members — rather than a cash ransom. The abduction of a senior retired military officer underscored the alarming reach of northwest banditry and the security vacuum in Katsina State, which has seen escalating kidnapping campaigns targeting prominent individuals.

media.caption: Katsina bandits abduct retired general and wife, demand prisoner exchange
